bureau: FICP (Banque de France, through the IEOM)
note: In French Polynesia, one of the Pacific collectivities, the IEOM answers the right of access to the Banque de France's file of repayment incidents (FICP); the file's rules are France's: listed once arrears equal the last two monthly installments and the lender's 30 days' warning runs out, written as 60 days, for five years at most. The 2013 order adapting the file to French Polynesia, on Légifrance, answers with a Cloudflare check, not passed. On 2026-11-03 the Banque de France's FICP page refused this environment (Akamai's 'Access Denied', to curl and to a rendering browser alike; Légifrance's text of the FICP's arrêté answered with a Cloudflare check, and archive.org didn't answer); Common Crawl's copy of the page of 8 September 2026 was read instead and still says what is quoted, so the page keeps its reading of 2026-10-30.

A défaut, l’établissement procèdera à votre inscription au FICP. ... La durée d’inscription est alors de cinq ans maximum.
